name: manim-skill
tagline_zh: 别再用AI生成千篇一律的丑动画了。这个Skill直接调用Manim引擎，把公式和算法变成3Blue1Brown级别。
tagline_en: Stop generic AI slop. This Skill drives Manim to turn equations and algorithms into 3Blue1Brown-grade animations.
desc_en: Create mathematical animations with Manim Community Edition(manimce). Generates distinctive, production-grade animations that avoid generic "AI slop" aesthetics. Use when user wants to animate concepts, equations, illustrate proofs, visualize algorithms, create math explainers, or produce 3Blue1Brown-style videos.
why_zh: 它直接生成Manim代码，而非套模板，所以每个动画都独一无二，且自动规避AI常见的塑料感。
why_en: It writes raw Manim code, not templates, so every animation is unique and free of AI's plastic feel—down to fonts and easing.
